deskyard key: press keys or shortcuts

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] key COMBO...

Presses keys one after another, in xdotool syntax: Return, Escape, Tab,
BackSpace, Up, F5, ctrl+l, ctrl+shift+t, super.

Arguments:
  COMBO      string...   required  a key or key combination

Prints: nothing

Examples:
  deskyard key ctrl+l
  deskyard key ctrl+a BackSpace

Where: inside a computer it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen computer (-c COMPUTER)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; otherwise the exit code of the action on the desktop
